g.text: Warm-started by imitating our rule-based bot, then trained with PPO against itself and that bot. 95% intervals; 800 games per point.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: * Evolved rival: never seen in training. Made by evolutionary program synthesis [read: Claude keeps rewriting the bot and we keep whatever wins].

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: Shown with trading off, since our bot can't trade. Our bot never proposes laws, talks or trades with players; it votes by the rule-based bot's rule.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8984

g.text: Wins at the round limit (most of them on the 10-round worlds) don't count as strength.
